plugins.name: kontext
plugins.description: Persistent, portable memory for your work. Save projects, tasks, docs, decisions, and reusable Skills to your own Kontext Space and recall them in any AI client.

skills.name: catch-up
skills.description: Load Kontext context for this repository or project before starting work
skills.description_zh: 开始工作前加载Kontext中当前仓库或项目的上下文。

skills.name: kontext-context
skills.description: Use Kontext as the user's system of record for durable AI work. Trigger when work may already exist, when a project or decision should survive this conversation, when task status changes, or when the user asks to retrieve, save, relate, archive, or maintain projects, tasks, documents, memories, conversations, and reusable skills. Do not trigger for incidental chat with no future value.
skills.description_zh: 将Kontext作为长期AI工作的记录系统，检索保存关联归档维护项目、任务、文档、记忆、对话和可复用技能，支持现有工作查询与任务状态变化，不用于无未来价值的随聊。

skills.name: kontext-memory
skills.description: Capture durable facts, decisions, and observations into Kontext as memories. Trigger when the user says to remember or save something, shares a fact with future value (a preference, price, deadline, credential-free detail), or asks what Kontext remembers. Do not trigger for secrets, incidental chat, or throwaway details.
skills.description_zh: 在Kontext记录长期事实、决定和观察，保存有未来用途的偏好、价格、期限及无凭据信息，支持记忆查询，不用于秘密或临时细节。

skills.name: kontext-sharing
skills.description: Work correctly with records shared to or by the user in Kontext. Trigger when the user mentions shared access, a collaborator's project, a readOnly record, or asks what they can edit in someone else's Space. Do not trigger for ordinary owned records.
skills.description_zh: 正确处理Kontext中用户共享或收到的记录，理解协作者项目、只读记录及他人Space可编辑范围，不用于普通自有记录。

skills.name: kontext-tasks
skills.description: Run work through Kontext's task loop. Trigger when the user starts a non-trivial task, asks to track or resume work, reports progress or a blocker, finishes something, or asks what to work on next. Do not trigger for one-off questions with no durable outcome.
skills.description_zh: 通过Kontext任务循环跟踪非简单工作、恢复任务、报告进展阻塞、完成事项及选择下一步，不用于无持久成果的一次性问题。

skills.name: log-decision
skills.description: Record a technical decision in Kontext with its rationale and rejected alternatives
headings: What makes it worth reading later
skills.description_zh: 在Kontext记录技术决策、理由及未采用的替代方案。

skills.name: recall
skills.description: Search Kontext for prior work, decisions, or notes on a topic
skills.description_zh: 在Kontext搜索某主题的既有工作、决策或笔记。

skills.name: save-skill
skills.description: Save a reusable Agent Skill to Kontext so it is available from any MCP client
skills.description_zh: 把可复用Agent Skill保存到Kontext，供各MCP客户端访问。

skills.name: save
skills.description: Save what this session produced to Kontext so a later session can pick it up
skills.description_zh: 将本会话成果保存到Kontext，便于后续会话接续。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Check that Kontext is connected and show what is in the user's Space
skills.description_zh: 检查Kontext是否连接并展示用户Space中的内容。
